# Cytrus
3DS emulation provided via [@jarrodnorwell](https://github.com/jarrodnorwell)'s port of Azahar by [@azahar-emu](https://github.com/azahar-emu) and [@citra-emu](https://github.com/citra-emu)

The vendored source is based on folium-app/Cytrus revision
`7da2596f986f5269aa819fc197d2b50b2dde7843`. Its upstream GPLv3
`LICENSE` is included here. Individual source files retain their own notices,
including GPLv2-or-later notices inherited from Citra and Azahar.
